title: AUTO FARM | INSTANT STEAL | AUTO PLACE, FEED, HATCH & BUY |
features:
🌾 Auto Farm System
​Auto Egg Farm: Automatically scans the map for target rare eggs (Volcanic Egg, Cherub Egg, Solaris Egg, Black Hole Egg, Bloom Egg, Galaxy Egg) based on an optimized priority ranking and path-flies to collect them.
​Auto Deliver & Ranch Deposit: Safely transports collected eggs back to your Ranch and auto-places/activates them.
​Smart Idle Hover: Automatically hovers safely above your Ranch while waiting for new eggs to spawn.
​Universal Interaction: Auto-fires TouchInterests, ProximityPrompts, and ClickDetectors upon arrival.
​🔮 Visuals & ESP
​Custom-Colored Egg ESP: Displays 3D Billboard text labels and distance trackers for all target eggs.
​Wall Highlights: Full-color fill and outline highlighting visible through walls (Orange/Red for Volcanic, Pink for Cherub, Gold for Solaris, Purple for Black Hole, Green for Bloom, Cyan for Galaxy).
​Auto-Cleaner: Dynamically updates and removes ESP tracking once an egg is collected or despawned.
​🚀 Teleport & Movement
​Fly to Ranch: Fast, smooth vector flight directly to your owned Ranch.
​Save Location: Store your current CFrame position and fly back to it anytime.
​CFrame Speed Boost: Custom RenderStepped speed modifier that bypasses standard HumanoidWalkSpeed resets.
​Auto Noclip: Automatically toggles collision off during active flight and auto-farming routines to prevent rubberbanding.
​⚙️ UI & Security
​Panda Auth V4: Secure Key System with built-in clipboard copying for key generation and automatic menu opening upon validation.
​Modern GUI: Fully draggable and minimizable tabbed interface (Teleport, ESP, Player, Farm).
